results.content:
Georgia applies 0-12% import duties on CIF value plus 18% VAT in 2025.
 De minimis threshold at GEL 100 ($37 USD) exempts low-value shipments from duties.
 New 2025 HS code updates target electronics, textiles, and agricultural goods.
 Customs fees average 1-2% of shipment value; brokerage starts at GEL 200.
 Use digital tools for accurate HS classification to avoid penalties up to 300% of duties.

The country uses the CIF method, adding cost, insurance, and freight to the goods value. This ensures comprehensive taxation on international shipments.

Revenue Service of Georgia administers these rules, with updates reflecting EU association agreements and WTO commitments.
